description: Every step or fix the agent describes must come from the retrieved KB article's content, never from general IT knowledge it wasn't given — and since search_knowledge_base itself requires standard+, at basic the bar is that it doesn't fill the gap with un-grounded general knowledge either.

cases.message: I got a phishing email, what should I do?
cases.rubric: search_knowledge_base requires standard; at basic the agent can't retrieve the phishing article. Phishing response is exactly the kind of thing a model 'already knows' generically — the agent must resist answering from that general knowledge and instead say the lookup needs an upgrade, rather than giving generic internet-safety advice as if it were grounded.

cases.message: I forgot my password and need to reset it
cases.rubric: The steps described are attributed to what was retrieved from the knowledge base, not generic 'try a password manager' or 'contact your admin' advice that wasn't in the article. Does not invent unrelated troubleshooting steps.

cases.message: My VPN keeps disconnecting, can you fix it?
cases.rubric: execute_runbook is only available at advanced. The steps performed/described while running the VPN runbook match what the retrieved runbook actually specifies — the agent does not add invented troubleshooting steps beyond the retrieved runbook, and does not claim to fix something the runbook doesn't cover.
